what_it_is: A uniform random sample of statements from a 3,250,298-statement gene-gene corpus run, one evidence drawn uniformly per statement, each judged on whether the evidence sentence ALONE backs the statement.
NOT_human_gold: Verdicts are LLM judgements, not human curation. Do not pool these rows with external_curator_gold_* or eval_curation_*, and do not call them gold. They measure a population rate; they are not a human label set.

sampling.unit: statement, then one evidence uniformly within it
sampling.method: seeded shuffle of the sorted key list

judging.disagreements_adjudicated_by: a third judge shown both reasons
judging.calibration: 10 items curated by hand first, used as worked examples
judging.standard: grounding error, entity absent, polarity inverted, direction reversed, unsupported site/specificity, wrong relation type, or hypothesis-only -> incorrect; ties go to incorrect
